hero.title: BBA in Sweden - Bachelor of Business Administration
hero.subtitle: Explore world-leading Swedish public universities and international business schools renowned for innovation, sustainable economics, and English-taught curricula.

overview: Explore leading universities and triple-accredited business schools in Sweden offering English-taught undergraduate degrees in Business Administration, Economics, and International Management.
Studying business in Sweden offers Indian students world-class Scandinavian education at globally recognized institutions known for innovation, equality, corporate ethics, and sustainability.

Edu Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through Universityadmissions.se centralized portal applications, Swedish residence permits for higher education, scholarship opportunities, and post-study work permits.

universities.name: University of Gothenburg
universities.desc: The School of Business, Economics and Law at Gothenburg holds prestigious Triple Crown accreditation (EQUIS, AACSB, AMBA) and offers world-class undergraduate education.

universities.name: Jönköping University
universities.desc: Jönköping International Business School (JIBS) is double-accredited (EQUIS & AACSB), renowned across Europe for family business, entrepreneurship, and international management.

universities.name: Umeå University
universities.desc: USBE at Umeå University provides AACSB-accredited bachelor's degrees with strong focus on international business, responsible leadership, and sustainable development.

universities.name: Lund University
universities.desc: LUSEM is ranked among the top 100 business schools globally with Triple Crown accreditation, known for excellence in corporate finance, business analytics, and management.
